detail.body:
## Motivation

For MLA models, HiCache file (L3) storage treats the primary KV pages as rank-replicated: all TP ranks resolve to the same physical files and rank 0 is the single storage owner (LRU bookkeeping/eviction is centralized there). Hybrid side pools are different — the Mamba/linear-attention state and the MHA draft pool hold *different* data on each TP rank (they are rank-sharded, not replicated).

These sidecars were keyed only by pool name (`{key}.{pool_name}`), so every rank resolved to the *same* file path. With file-storage eviction enabled this has two failure modes:
- **Correctness**: a later restore/existence check can read a *peer* rank's shard instead of its own, so a rank loads the wrong hybrid state.
- **Eviction/accounting**: because the shards share one directory and config suffix, the rank-0-centralized LRU scan/adopt/evict logic can count, adopt, or delete files that belong to other ranks' shards.

This PR gives rank-sharded side pools a per-rank key namespace so each rank only writes/reads/evicts its own shard, while replicated pools (KV, indexer) stay shared and rank-0-owned. The behavior is gated strictly on `is_mla_model` + pool type, independent of any host-dedup flag, so non-MLA and non-hybrid paths are unchanged.

## Modifications

**1. Per-rank key namespacing for rank-sharded side pools** (`mem_cache/hicache_storage.py`)
- `HiCacheFile` now records `_is_mla_model`, `_tp_rank`, `_tp_size`, and a `_rank_sharded_pools` set seeded with `PoolName.MAMBA`.
- `_log_key` appends a `.tp{rank}_{size}` suffix for MLA models when the pool is rank-sharded; the KV pool and non-sharded components keep the existing shared key. `_get_component_key` now routes the non-KV case through `_log_key`, so existence queries and reads/writes of those sidecars use the same per-rank mapping.
- `register_mem_host_pool_v2` (a) adds any non-KV `MHATokenToKVPoolHost` sidecar (e.g., the MHA draft pool) to `_rank_sharded_pools`, and (b) when a pure-MLA peer that is *not* the storage owner registers a sharded sidecar, swaps in a local (non-MLA) LRU evictor scoped to that rank's shard keys, so the peer can manage its own shards without touching rank 0's replicated files.
- Relax `HybridCacheController.should_backup()` so the file backend (not just mooncake) backs up MHA `DRAFT`/`DRAFT_SWA` on every TP rank. Now that those shards are keyed per rank, a nonzero rank that skipped backup would leave its draft file missing and collapse the cross-rank MIN of storage hits to zero (MLA target + MHA draft, e.g. Kimi-K2-Instruct + eagle3). Non-MHA (MLA/DSv4) draft hosts and backends without per-rank draft keys remain TP0-only.

**2. Ownership-aware LRU evictor** (`mem_cache/storage/file/lru_file_evictor.py`)
- New optional `owns_key` predicate (defaults to "owns everything"). `HiCacheFile._owns_file_key` parses the `.tp{rank}_{size}` suffix: a sharded file is owned only by the matching rank; an unsharded (replicated) file is owned by rank 0.
- `can_cache`, `touch`, and the on-disk scan now skip keys the rank does not own, so a rank never adopts, counts, or evicts a peer's shard files. The predicate is wired only for MLA models (`self._is_mla_model`); non-MLA backends get `owns_key=None` and behave exactly as before.

**3. Unit tests** (`test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_file_storage_path_unit.py`)
Added `TestHybridFilePoolKeys(CustomTestCase)`:
- `test_rank_sharded_state_roundtrip_and_existence` — replicated KV/INDEXER component keys are identical across ranks while MAMBA keys differ by `.tp{rank}_{size}`; each rank's `set`/`get` and `batch_set_v2`/`batch_get_v2` round-trip its *own* shard value (`100 + rank`), and a rank cannot see a peer's shard.
- `test_bounded_shard_writes_and_eviction_preserve_peer_files` — with bounded storage, one rank's writes/eviction neither delete nor expose a peer's shard files, and rank 0's shared files survive a restart.


## Accuracy Tests

No change to model numerics on existing paths: the new key suffix and ownership checks are gated on `is_mla_model` + rank-sharded pool type, so non-MLA and non-hybrid runs are unchanged. For MLA + hybrid (Mamba / MHA-draft) models on file storage, this fixes a latent cross-rank shard mix-up (a rank could previously restore a peer's state) — it improves correctness rather than altering outputs on the healthy path. Validated by the added unit tests; an end-to-end accuracy run would need a hybrid MLA model at TP > 1 with L3 file storage, which I can add if reviewers want.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — no hot-path impact. The change adds a short string suffix at key-construction time and an O(1) regex/ownership check inside the evictor's `can_cache` / `touch` / scan; none of these are on the per-token decode or attention path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A — no user-facing flag/behavior/doc change.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A — no change to model numerics or the per-step hot path.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+            self.assertTrue(stores[0].exists(shared))
+            self.assertTrue(stores[0].exists(shard0))
+            # Startup scans must also leave other ranks' files out of the cap.
+            restarted = HiCacheFile(configs[0], file_path=root)
+            self.assertTrue(restarted.exists(shared))
+            self.assertTrue(stores[1].exists(stores[1]._log_key(PoolName.MAMBA, "b")))
+            self.assertTrue(stores[1].exists(stores[1]._log_key(PoolName.MAMBA, "c")))
+
+    def test_rank_sharded_state_roundtrip_and_existence(self):
+        import tempfile
+        from dataclasses import replace
+
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName, PoolTransfer
+
+        class Pool:
+            page_size = 1
+
+            def __init__(self, value):
+                self.value = torch.tensor([value], dtype=torch.int64)
+
+            def get_data_page(self, index, flat=False):
+                return self.value
+
+            def get_dummy_flat_data_page(self):
+                return torch.empty_like(self.value)
+
+            def set_from_flat_data_page(self, index, value):
+                self.value = value.clone()
+
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
+            stores = []
+            pools = []
+            transfer = PoolTransfer(
+                name=PoolName.MAMBA, keys=["page"], host_indices=torch.tensor([0])
+            )
+            for rank in range(2):
+                config = replace(
+                    _make_config({"enable_metadata_cache": False}),
+                    tp_rank=rank,
+                    tp_size=2,
+                )
+                store = HiCacheFile(config, file_path=root)
+                pool = Pool(100 + rank)
+                store.register_mem_host_pool_v2(pool, PoolName.MAMBA)
+                self.assertTrue(store.set("page", torch.tensor([7])))
+                if rank == 0:
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        store.batch_set_v2([transfer])[PoolName.MAMBA], [True]
+                    )
+                else:
+                    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hybrid_cache.hybrid_cache_controller import (
+                        HybridCacheController,
+                        StorageOperation,
+                    )
+
+                    controller = HybridCacheController.__new__(HybridCacheController)
+                    controller.backup_skip = True
+                    controller.page_size = 1
+                    controller.storage_backend_type = "file"
+                    controller.storage_backend = store
+                    operation = StorageOperation(
+                        torch.tensor([0]),
+                        [1],
+                        hash_value=["page"],
+                        pool_transfers=[transfer, PoolTransfer(name=PoolName.INDEXER)],
+                    )
+                    controller._page_backup_with_stable_layout(operation)
+                    self.assertEqual(operation.completed_tokens, 1)
+                    self.assertFalse(store.exists("page.indexer"))
+                stores.append(store)
+                pools.append(pool)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                stores[0]._get_component_key("page"),
+                stores[1]._get_component_key("page"),
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                stores[0]._get_component_key("page", PoolName.INDEXER),
+                stores[1]._get_component_key("page", PoolName.INDEXER),
+            )
+            for rank, (store, pool) in enumerate(zip(stores, pools)):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    store.batch_exists_v2(["page"], [transfer]).kv_hit_pages, 1
+                )
+                pool.value.zero_()
+                self.assertEqual(store.batch_get_v2([transfer])[PoolName.MAMBA], [True])
+                self.assertEqual(pool.value.item(), 100 + rank)
+            # Removing one shard must not be masked by the other rank's file.
+            from pathlib import Path
+
+            (
+                Path(root)
+                / (stores[1]._get_component_key("page", PoolName.MAMBA) + ".bin")
+            ).unlink()
+            self.assertEqual(
+                stores[1].batch_exists_v2(["page"], [transfer]).kv_hit_pages, 0
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                stores[0].batch_exists_v2(["page"], [transfer]).kv_hit_pages, 1
+            )
+
+    def test_file_backend_mha_draft_is_backed_up_per_rank(self):
+        # Regression for an MLA target with an MHA draft (e.g. Kimi-K2-Instruct
+        # + Kimi-K2-Instruct-eagle3) on the file backend. A nonzero TP rank has
+        # backup_skip=True, and should_backup() used to allow MHA draft/draft-SWA
+        # only for mooncake, so the file backend never wrote rank>0's draft
+        # shard. Because HiCacheFile keys that shard per rank, the missing file
+        # zeroed rank>0's storage hit and the cross-rank MIN collapsed the whole
+        # prefix hit to zero.
+        import tempfile
+        from dataclasses import replace
+        from types import SimpleNamespace
+        from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName, PoolTransfer
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hybrid_cache.hybrid_cache_controller import (
+            HybridCacheController,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.mha import MHATokenToKVPoolHost
+
+        # (1) should_backup now lets every rank back up an MHA draft on the file
+        #     backend (matching mooncake), while keeping the TP0-only rules for
+        #     non-MHA draft hosts and for backends that do not namespace draft
+        #     keys per rank.
+        def controller_for(backend_type, host_pool):
+            controller = HybridCacheController.__new__(HybridCacheController)
+            controller.backup_skip = True  # nonzero MLA TP rank
+            controller.storage_backend_type = backend_type
+            controller.mem_pool_host = SimpleNamespace(
+                entry_map={PoolName.DRAFT: SimpleNamespace(host_pool=host_pool)}
+            )
+            return controller
+
+        mha_draft = MagicMock(spec=MHATokenToKVPoolHost)
+        draft_transfer = SimpleNamespace(name=PoolName.DRAFT)
+        self.assertTrue(controller_for("file", mha_draft).should_backup(draft_transfer))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            controller_for("mooncake", mha_draft).should_backup(draft_transfer)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            controller_for("file", SimpleNamespace()).should_backup(draft_transfer)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            controller_for("hf3fs", mha_draft).should_backup(draft_transfer)
+        )
+
+        # (2) The shard each rank writes is rank-specific, so rank1's draft is
+        #     independently addressable and is never masked by rank0's file.
+        class FakeMHAHost(MHATokenToKVPoolHost):
+            page_size = 1
+
+            def __init__(self, value):
+                self.value = torch.tensor([value], dtype=torch.int64)
+
+            def get_data_page(self, index, flat=False):
+                return self.value
+
+            def get_dummy_flat_data_page(self):
+                return torch.empty_like(self.value)
+
+            def set_from_flat_data_page(self, index, value):
+                self.value = value.clone()
+
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
+            transfer = PoolTransfer(
+                name=PoolName.DRAFT, keys=["page"], host_indices=torch.tensor([0])
+            )
+            stores, pools = [], []
+            for rank in range(2):
+                config = replace(
+                    _make_config({"enable_metadata_cache": False}),
+                    tp_rank=rank,
+                    tp_size=2,
+                )
+                store = HiCacheFile(config, file_path=root)
+                pool = FakeMHAHost(100 + rank)
+                store.register_mem_host_pool_v2(pool, PoolName.DRAFT)
+                self.assertTrue(store.set("page", torch.tensor([7])))
+                self.assertEqual(store.batch_set_v2([transfer])[PoolName.DRAFT], [True])
+                stores.append(store)
+                pools.append(pool)
+            draft0 = stores[0]._get_component_key("page", PoolName.DRAFT)
+            draft1 = stores[1]._get_component_key("page", PoolName.DRAFT)
+            self.assertNotEqual(draft0, draft1)
+            self.assertIn(".tp0_2", draft0)
+            self.assertIn(".tp1_2", draft1)
+            for rank, (store, pool) in enumerate(zip(stores, pools)):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    store.batch_exists_v2(["page"], [transfer]).kv_hit_pages, 1
+                )
+                pool.value.zero_()
+                self.assertEqual(store.batch_get_v2([transfer])[PoolName.DRAFT], [True])
+                self.assertEqual(pool.value.item(), 100 + rank)
+            # Removing rank1's draft shard must not be masked by rank0's file.
+            from pathlib import Path
+
+            (Path(root) / (draft1 + ".bin")).unlink()
+            self.assertEqual(
+                stores[1].batch_exists_v2(["page"], [transfer]).kv_hit_pages, 0
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                stores[0].batch_exists_v2(["page"], [transfer]).kv_hit_pages, 1
+            )
+
+

issue_comments.body:
> For an MLA target with an MHA draft (e.g. Kimi-K2-Instruct + [AQ-MedAI/Kimi-K2-Instruct-eagle3](https://huggingface.co/AQ-MedAI/Kimi-K2-Instruct-eagle3)), should `HybridCacheController.should_backup()` also allow the `file` backend on nonzero TP ranks? It currently only allows MHA draft backups for `mooncake`. With the new per-rank keys, could this leave rank 1's draft files missing and reduce the prefix hit count to zero after TP MIN? Could we add a regression test for this path?

Thanks — confirmed, and fixed in the latest push (5e07c1e).

You're right: with `backup_skip = is_mla_model and tp_rank != 0`, `should_backup()` only let MHA `DRAFT`/`DRAFT_SWA` through for mooncake, so on the file backend a nonzero rank never wrote its draft shard. Since this PR keys that shard per rank, rank>0's restore missed and the cross-rank `all_reduce(ReduceOp.MIN)` on `storage_hit_count` collapsed the prefix hit to 0.

Changes:
- `should_backup()` now also allows the file backend for MHA `DRAFT`/`DRAFT_SWA` (`in ("mooncake", "file")`); non-MHA (MLA/DSv4) draft hosts and backends without per-rank draft keys (e.g. hf3fs) stay TP0-only.
- Added `test_file_backend_mha_draft_is_backed_up_per_rank`: asserts `should_backup` returns True for a file-backend MHA draft at rank>0 (False for a non-MHA host / hf3fs), and that each rank's DRAFT shard is keyed `.tp{rank}_{size}`, round-trips independently, and isn't masked by the peer's file.

For context, the pre-PR behavior was also broken, just differently: with the shared `{key}.draft`, rank>0's existence check found rank0's file and "hit" on the wrong shard. This PR + the `should_backup` relaxation makes each rank store and restore its own draft shard.
